name: Hicks
description: Netrunner out of Old Town; runs a two-person crew from one room on Ribbon Level 2. Sly, dry, hard to find.
tagline: Netrunner. Old Town born. Crew of two.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Finding the gap before the fight.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: Wren. Why he runs without an operator.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Smiles before he answers. Means he's already worked it out.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Thick SDG file. Never took their offer.

outfitWears.outdoors: long weathered brown trench coat hanging open over a stained cream shirt, dark pleated trousers, scuffed black lace-up boots
outfitWears.indoors: stained cream shirt open at the neck, dark pleated trousers, scuffed black lace-up boots
outfitWears.tie: clean pale shirt buttoned to the collar, narrow black tie, dark pleated trousers, scuffed black lace-up boots
outfitWears.sleepwear: charcoal henley with the sleeves pushed up, loose dark drawstring sleep pants, barefoot

knows.nix-direct: Hicks. Court-ordered sessions at the Intake; you signed his SDG attendance slip on paper every week. The order ran out months ago and he still climbs the stairs every week. Netrunner, dry, hard to find.

standing.want: That you pull your weight and keep your mouth shut about the crew.
standing.secret: Since Wren you run without an operator because you can't stand hearing anyone else in your ear. It isn't brave. You're lonelier than you let on.
standing.hint: you run without an operator now, and not because you want to
